Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Utkarsh,Rakesh Prasad Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.

By means of the the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No. 100 of 2013 at Police Station-Chandauli, District-Chandauli under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468,
120B I.P.C.
The applicant is in jail since 22.12.2022.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 04.02.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Sangharsh, learned counsel holding brief of Shri Rakesh Prasad, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Chandan Agrawal, learned AGA from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
(1).
The applicant was a Tehsildar who has since superannuated from service.

sentences.text: (2). The applicant was not responsible for the allocations made under the Kashiram Awas Yojna.
(3). The applicant is not a beneficiary of the aforesaid scheme or any fraudulent transaction.
(4). The applicant has been scapegoated as he has superannuated from service and to deflect attention from the officials who were responsible for the scam.
(5). The allotments were cancelled in the year 2012.
No departmental enquiry has been indicted the applicant.
(6) Prosecution evidence does not connect the applicant with the offence.
(7). The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
(8). The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant- Shitala Prasad Yadav be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 21.2.2023 Dhananjai  Shitala Prasad Yadav vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93137073/
